units: Targ. Ex. XV, 25; a. fr.—Part. pass. בְּסִים, v. בָּסִים.

senses.gloss: to sweeten, season; trnsf. to make happy, to delight.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 18:19">Targ. Y. Num. XVIII, 19</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 50:2">Targ. Y. Gen. L, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 50:26">26</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְבַסַּם</he>. Targ. O. XXX, 25.

senses.gloss: to be cheerful, feel the wine; cmp. בְּלוּזְמָא.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:2">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דאִיבְּסוּם</he> when they were feeling the wine.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:7">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>מיחייב אינש לִבְּסוּמֵי וכ׳</he> (= <he>לאיבסומי</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) one must cheer himself up with wine &c.
